Agent Studio
# Shopping just got a lot more conversational
Agent Studio brings intelligent, automated guidance into onsite discovery so buyers can move forward with less friction.
[ Get a demo ](https://www.algolia.com/demorequest)
[ Start building for free ](https://dashboard.algolia.com/users/sign_up)
##  Shoppers want guidance that feels as personalas an in-store expert
When your experience cannot interpret complex needs, customers work harder to find the right product. Agent Studio turns that friction into guided answers and clearer next steps, creating opportunities to convert high-intent shoppers. Built on Algolia’s search, retrieval, and MCP foundation, Agent Studio turns your trusted data into branded onsite agents that guide shoppers to confident product decisions.
##  Launch native agentic experiences faster 
Use Agent Studio templates and the SDK to launch AI Mode, product page questions, and guided discovery flows directly in your onsite experience. 
##### Agentic search bar
Let customers type natural product questions into the search bar and move from traditional search into guided discovery. 
##### Product page questions
Add clickable, suggested questions to product pages, then open a guided answer experience when customers need more detail. 
##### Guided selling
Guide customers through complex choices with recommendations based on needs, preferences, constraints, and buying context. 
##### Fitment and compatibility
Match customers with products that fit their size, space, routine, use case, or technical requirement. 
##### Product comparison
Show tradeoffs across specs, bundles, alternatives, and price points so customers can choose with confidence. 
##### Product answers beyond the page
Answer product, shipping, returns, warranty, and compatibility questions using trusted content from the right sources and indices. 
##  Ground AI in the data you trust
Build on your Algolia index, product data, reviews, content, business rules, relevance signals, and shopper context so AI can retrieve the right products and answers instead of guessing.
##  Built for teams that need control
Keep guidance focused 0
Define what the experience should and should not respond to, so the agent stays aligned to your catalog, policies, use case, and brand.
Choose how business rules shape results 0
Use Algolia relevance settings, business rules, and merchandising priorities to influence what gets retrieved, recommended, and shown.
Cost controls before launch 0
Manage cost and scale with token usage visibility, caching, rate limiting, and configuration options designed to reduce unnecessary LLM calls.
Maintain brand trust 0
Define tone, approved sources, and response boundaries so the experience feels consistent, useful, and appropriate for your customers.
##  Transform customer uncertainty into revenue
Agent Studio helps shoppers move past hesitation and dead ends with follow-up questions, product comparisons, fit validation, and recommendations grounded in your catalog, so more high-intent customers keep moving toward purchase. 
##### Understand complex questions
Interpret what customers mean, retrieve the right products and context, and keep discovery moving when keywords or filters fall short. 
##### Reduce zero-result dead ends
Guide customers to a relevant next step when search returns no results, turning dead ends into another path to purchase. 
##### Deliver better recommendations
Use product data, availability, compatibility, context, and relevance signals to recommend products that match each customer’s needs. 
##### Start with the entry point customers trust
Turn the search bar shoppers already use into a conversational experience where they can ask questions, compare options, and get guidance beyond traditional results. 
##### Learn from every interaction
View analytics, conversation history, and message feedback to understand response quality, identify gaps, and improve the experience over time. 
##### Measure what converts
Understand which questions, journeys, and guided experiences lead to conversion, revenue, and ROI. 
### Developer-ready by design
Agent Studio gives developers the building blocks to make agentic discovery feel native to the customer experience.
With the SDK, templates, and connectors, developers can embed guided experiences into the places customers already make decisions.

##  Algolia Agent Studio FAQs 
What is Agent Studio? 0
Agent Studio is a platform for building and launching intelligent agents grounded in live Algolia search data. It enables agentic experiences that are accurate, brand-safe, governed, and scalable by building directly on top of Algolia’s AI Retrieval Platform.
How is Agent Studio different from generic agent builders or chatbots? 0
Agent Studio is retrieval-first, not model-first. Responses are grounded in live Algolia indices, merchandising, rules, and relevance stay centralized, governance and brand safety are stronger, and hallucinations are reduced compared to generic LLM-only agents.
How does Agent Studio differentiate from LangChain, OpenAI agent builders, etc.? 0
Many agent frameworks are designed for experimentation and require teams to assemble retrieval, orchestration, governance, and infrastructure themselves. Agent Studio is designed for production from day one with a built-in retrieval layer, visual configuration, templates, and enterprise-scale infrastructure. Customers can still use external frameworks if they choose, and Algolia can act as the retrieval and control layer even when other frameworks are used. Some customers prefer LangChain for advanced experimentation such as multi-LLM testing, and the value of switching is not always obvious to those teams.
How are you grounding your agentic experiences in real-time, accurate data? 0
While many AI solutions can be helpful, they can "hallucinate" answers. Agent Studio prevents hallucinations because it uses your up-to-the-minute data. It retrieves information from your structured search index to augment its generated responses with that data, an approach appropriately called Retrieval Augmented Generation, or RAG. 
Is Agent Studio designed for my industry? 0
Yes. Agent Studio supports use cases across every industry—from SaaS and media to enterprise search and beyond—making it adaptable to virtually any AI agent need.
What types of Large Language Models (LLMs) does Agent Studio support? 0
Agent Studio lets you use your preferred large language model (LLM) provider, with support for Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, and OpenAI-compatible models. View the [full list of supported models](https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/algolia-ai/agent-studio/how-to/llm-providers#provider-overview).
Choose a model based on your requirements like relevance, speed, and cost. Use the [LLM Leaderboard](http://www.algolia.com/llm-leaderboard) to compare options and find what fits your use case.
Can I use non-product data in agents? 0
Yes. Agents can access any data indexed in Algolia, including help docs, guides, and more.
What is "user memory" in the dashboard? 0
Many LLMs and agentic solutions lack memory from session to session or query to query. Unlike those solutions, Algolia’s Agent Studio has a [built-in memory function](https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/algolia-ai/agent-studio/how-to/memory/overview). User memory is an optional setting that lets an agent remember user preferences and past outcomes so responses can stay consistent across interactions. Our customers can use this feature to provide more personalized agentic conversations to their visitors and buyers.
How does Agent Studio use my data? 0
Agent Studio uses your first-party data—such as search interactions, transaction history, and user behavior—to generate highly relevant, brand-specific responses. Unlike generic agent frameworks, it integrates this data directly from your Algolia indices, giving your agents context-aware intelligence out of the box.
